description: Check whether a person is a current or recent politically exposed person (PEP): head of state or government, minister, member of parliament, senior judge, ambassador, central bank head or senior military officer, in any country. Built from official government publications (national parliaments, lists of government leaders) and open public records. Fuzzy match across other spellings and scripts. Each hit lists the offices held with dates and status (current, former or unconfirmed), a date of birth and country comparison, and the sources that confirm it. Family members and close associates are not covered. Costs $0.02.

country.description: Country the person is from or holds office in

threshold.description: Minimum match score (default is stricter than screen_name)

name: screen_pep
